messages:
Marco: Heads-up: quick postmortem synthesis from last night's GPU surge. I'm assembling a short runbook + owner map. Need confirmations on quotas, scheduler knobs, and headroom targets. TL;DR: spikes from long-running batching jobs + not enough headroom.
Leah: Thanks — can you paste the action list you're proposing? I can own the runbook PR.
Marco: Proposed actions (short):
1) Scheduler tuning: lower preemption threshold for batch nodes, adjust bin-packing weights (INC-3421)
2) Quota: request provisional +20% GPU pool for peak windows (OPS-201)
3) Headroom: set autoscaler buffer to 15% and cooldown to 30s; add metric-based alerts
4) Runbook: add a surge triage checklist with exact commands + escalation contacts
5) Owner rotation: create 2-week gpu-capacity oncall and checklist for handoff
Devon: I can own 1 and 3. Will validate scheduler tweak in staging and run load test. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
AJ: I'll open OPS-201 with cloud infra and tag billing; can we get a provisional quota for the next 24h while we validate? @ops-bot can you note that?
ops-bot: Incident closed: GPU surge 2025-08-14 02:30Z. Reminder created: create follow-up tasks and assign owners.
Leah: I'll do the runbook PR. Can someone drop the exact kubectl / patch snippets we used so I can paste them in the doc? Prefer short, copy-paste-friendly commands.
Devon: quick snippets to start with:
```
# scale batch workers
kubectl scale deployment gpu-batch -n inference --replicas=30
# example patch for scheduler preemption threshold
kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"preemptionThreshold":"0.6"}}'
```
AJ: I opened OPS-201 and linked INC-3421. Tagged cloud-team and sales-billing for provisional approve. If quota approved I'll update runbook and ping #eng-sre.
Leah: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/128 — marked WIP/DO NOT MERGE until quota confirmed. Added a draft surge checklist and the commands above.
Devon: Testing note: in staging lowering preemption threshold shaved tail latency by ~12% under mixed load. I'll push perf graphs to dashboards and add a perf-check in the PR.
Marco: Good. Owners: Devon (scheduler + headroom), AJ (quota + cloud requests), Leah (runbook + PR). Marco will coordinate reviews and follow-ups. Let's meet for a quick triage tomorrow 10:00 PT to sign off and schedule the provisional quota window. Recurring check-ins weekly for 4 weeks after sign-off.
ops-bot: Calendar: follow-up meeting scheduled for 2025-08-15 10:00 PT. Invite sent to participants.
Leah: :thumbsup:
AJ: Added tasks to sprint board: sprint/2025-34, lane: infra-high.
Marco: Thanks — I'll update the incident tracker with owner map and link PR + tickets. If anyone finds a missing item ping me here and I'll append.
